Class ShapeFactory

The base class for all SF Shapes.

Syntax
public class ShapeFactory : MonoBehaviour
Remarks

This class is not marked as abstract so it can be instantiated than assigned to on the fly while the initial instantiation can implement a constructor.

It also will use a struct for shape data to allow for some performance and memory usages when copying it's path data into stuff like Unity's UnityEngine.PhysicsShape2D class.
